name: third-eye
description: THIRD EYE — AI-Native Terminal Workspace powered by Electron, node-pty, and GPT-4o diagnostics

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "PTY-SVC,AI-SVC,SF-SVC,FRONTEND,ELECTRON" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan" "npm --prefix backend/pty-service run start" "npm --prefix backend/ai-service run start" "npm --prefix backend/salesforce-service run start" "npm --prefix Frontend/guide-build-main run dev" "electron ."
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -k -n "PTY-SVC,AI-SVC,SF-SVC,FRONTEND,ELECTRON" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan" "npm --prefix backend/pty-service run start" "npm --prefix backend/ai-service run start" "npm --prefix backend/salesforce-service run start" "npm --prefix Frontend/guide-build-main run dev" "electron ."
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -k -n "PTY,AI,SF" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm --prefix backend/pty-service run start" "npm --prefix backend/ai-service run start" "npm --prefix backend/salesforce-service run start"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:electron

author: THIRD EYE Team
